description: HTML source code for a database viewer web interface, including structure, styles, and client-side script for interacting with a backend API to display database and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets selections, and updates UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's tables list, fetches tables if needed.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database and renders them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling wide content and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better viewing.
